newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pacific BBA sees higher gearing by year end.
newsitem.headline: Pacific BBA sees higher gearing by year end.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Pacific BBA Ltd said on Tuesday that it expected its gearing to rise above 70 percent by the end of calendar 1998 from its June 30 level of 51 percent.
"Gearing will go up because of our capital expenditure programme. We expect it will be in the mid-70s by the end of the year," finance director Jim Cook told a media briefing.
Cook said the rise in debt would be mainly attributable to the funding of the construction of the group's A$100 million brake caliper plant in Knoxville, Tennessee.
"Gearing should come back progressively in 1998," he said.
